findings: S7 has no record in any world: no record speaks to the dead in dreams or a felt presence; the dreams on record are the living ones (Ciceronian dream, Constantine, Maximianus).

Rendering is concentrated: gallic holds 8 of 30 on-topic stories and nearly all quotes; lpc, rzg and alx have none, and cappadocian has nothing on S1-S4; Cassian Conf. VII and VIII are vendored and cited by no record.

Overreach risks: desert.story.antony-tomb-combat absent_detail calls the beast-demons a chosen register, not a literal claim; gallic.term.the-devil-demons says real and visible. cappadocian.term.martys-martyrion not_for says this world denied worship of martyrs, with the homilies unacquired.
